patches.name: Disable ad slot flags
patches.description: Forces every boolean in the server-driven AdsConfigModel to false, so no ad slot is created at all. Reads the fields at patch time, so it is not tied to obfuscated field names.

patches.name: Remove in-app ads
patches.description: Emits AdsAdModel.Empty for every ad placement, so calendar banners, in-feed ad cards and premium-upsell ad slots are never rendered. Anchored on unobfuscated domain types and reuses the app's own method ids.

patches.name: Remove splash/open ads
patches.description: Forces the splash ad screen to take its built-in "no ad to show" path, so no full screen ad covers the app on cold start.
